title: Sound Pattern
description:
Represents a specific sound effect. Used for the Sound Box / Sound Recorder / ( Portable ) Sound Dampener . Has the sound it "contains" in its name & tooltip.

A blank pattern holds no sound and is filled with a Sound Recorder. A recorded pattern shows the sound name in its item name and the full sound id in its tooltip, and looks different from a blank one. Sneak and right click with a pattern in your hand to clear its sound; this empties every pattern in the held stack. Recorded patterns can be taken out of a Sound Box by right clicking it. The Sound Dampeners only accept recorded patterns, while the Sound Box accepts both kinds.
